notes.title: New: Safe Mode
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

I’ve just added a [b]'safe mode'[/b] for those of you who want to experience all the horror atmosphere without being permanently pressured by the monster. 

You can activate ‘safe mode’ in the starting room and once activated (indicated by the little red light) it stays active until you manually deactivate it. I would suggest to only activate safe mode if the regular game is too intense for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45105307/2b6db45251ebd6d74f8fa2dd3ca27ab917c5906a.png[/img]

V 1.04 Patch Notes:
[list]
[*] new “safe” game mode
[*] fixed missing collisions near the furnace 
[*] fixed minor visual bugs
[/list]

As always, I’m excited to hear your feedback and if you encounter any issues, please report them [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3103480/discussions/1/4632609289965463733/]here[/url]

Best,
Hermann

notes.title: Update: Left-Handed Mode & More Improvements
notes.content:
Hey guys,
I've just added an input swap option to make things more comfortable for left-handed players. You’ll find the button to activate left-handed mode right in the physical menu in the starting room, just as usual. 
This update also brings a few minor visual improvements and performance tweaks.

V 1.02 Patch Notes:
[list]
[*] Left-handed mode / input swap option added
[*] Fixed LOD issues (no more pop-ins!)
[*] General performance enhancements
[*] Updated credits
[/list]

If you run into any bugs or issues, please share them here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/3103480/discussions/1/4632609289965463733/

And as always, I’m excited to hear your feedback!

Best,
Hermann

tags.feature: Left-handed mode / input swap option added
